reason: Prioritize small changes to the active panel32 compute loop, then the bounded 64 KiB B-panel layout. Scheduling has lower layout and allocation risk; the panel layout tests useful reuse directly, but its packing cost is unmeasured. Prefetch and counter changes have less expected benefit. Scratch blocking and transpose fusion restructure the active path, while padded A slices lack evidence of cache conflicts. The 1 MiB B layout adds substantial timed traffic. Direct A packing affects the fallback, not the fixed n=512 path. No proposal has measured evidence of improvement.
